login.twoFactorHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication (2FA)
twoFactor.desc: Protect your account with a TOTP authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Aegis, 1Password…).
twoFactor.scanQr: 1. Scan this QR code with your authenticator app or copy the secret key below:
twoFactor.confirmLabel: 2. Enter the 6-digit code to confirm activation
twoFactor.recoveryWarn: These 8 codes are shown only once. Each code can sign you in once if you lose access to your device.
twoFactor.disableHint: To disable 2FA, confirm with your password and a TOTP code (or recovery code).

users.title: User accounts

users.allAccessHint: Full administrator access to all servers.
users.deleteDesc: This permanently deletes the account and its server permissions.
users.resetHint: Active sessions for this user will be revoked immediately.
